g.title: The actor can distinguish established current state from unknown commitment; committed work is preserved and inspection supplies no new decision or approval.
The coherent prior state remains authoritative; retry is a new explicit decision using current context.
Inspection exposes the committed state; it is not rolled back or duplicated to repair missing output.
Report safe unavailability; do not replace the store, guess a repair or overwrite foreign content.
Report only the established busy/unavailable outcome; a later fresh read may retry inspection without replaying semantic decisions.
